hooks.command: bash -c 'export PATH="/c/Program Files/nodejs:$HOME/AppData/Roaming/npm:$PATH"; FILE=$(cat | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.filePath // empty" 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$FILE" == *.ts || "$FILE" == *.tsx ]]; then npx @biomejs/biome check --write "$FILE" 2>&1 | tail -5 || true; fi'

hooks.prompt: Review the recent changes. Check: 1) Are there new functions/components without corresponding .test.ts files? 2) Are imports following FSD layer rules (shared cannot import entities/features/app; entities cannot import features/app)? 3) Is backend domain/ free of infrastructure imports? 4) Any unused variables or dead code? Reply {"ok": true} if clean, or {"ok": false, "reason": "list specific issues found"} with specific actionable issues.

hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.filePath // empty" 2>/dev/null); CONTENT=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.new_string // .tool_input.content // empty" 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$FILE" == *server/domain/* ]] && echo "$CONTENT" | grep -qE "from.*(infrastructure|sqlite|better-sqlite|node:fs|node:child_process)"; then echo "BLOCKED: Domain layer must not import infrastructure" >&2; exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.filePath // empty" 2>/dev/null); CONTENT=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.new_string // .tool_input.content // empty" 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$FILE" == *shared/* ]] && echo "$CONTENT" | grep -qE "from.*(features|entities)/"; then echo "BLOCKED: Shared layer cannot import from features/entities (FSD violation)" >&2; exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.filePath // empty" 2>/dev/null); CONTENT=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.new_string // .tool_input.content // empty" 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$FILE" == *entities/* ]] && echo "$CONTENT" | grep -qE "from.*(features|app)/"; then echo "BLOCKED: Entities layer cannot import from features/app (FSD violation)" >&2; exit 2; fi'
bash -c 'echo "REMINDER: Before finishing, verify: 1) npm test passes 2) npx tsc --noEmit has no errors 3) npx @biomejs/biome check . is clean 4) Test API endpoints 5) Check UI renders" >&2'
